records.part: Upgrade of existing Biograph mCT & Vision system with the AIDAN Clin Apps Pkg.- mCT/Vision, including additional software features and new patient positioning equipment
records.reason: The original equipment manufacturer (OEM), Siemens, is the only contractor who can provide the system upgrade and as such is a logical follow-on to the original contract, due to the need to operate with existing OEM’S components and the proprietary nature of the hardware and software.
